# ROBORAB: full page text (English)

Implementing artificial intelligence
into business  processes
How we implement it
AI integration for business: diagnosis first, solution second
Tell the AI agent in the chat about your business at any time, even at 3 a.m. It will uncover your real problems instead of pushing tools on you. A specialist will review the summary and propose a solution: a ready-made product from the catalog, a custom solution or a website.
If you do not need AI, we will not implement it.

Frequently asked questions
What is ROBORAB? ROBORAB implements AI agents into companies' business processes. You can start with free diagnostics in chat, choose a ready-made solution from the catalog, or order a solution for your business.
How do you implement artificial intelligence in business processes? You describe the task to the AI agent by text, voice or video call. The agent writes a summary of your request, a technical specialist customizes a ready-made solution for you, and the next day the tool is already in the app.
How much does AI implementation cost? Diagnostics in chat is free. Implementation (Integrator) is priced individually: you can get a cost estimate in the chat within 10 minutes.
Which ready-made solutions are in the catalog? Fitness CRM, a tax agent for a group of companies, construction accounting, a booking CRM for hotel requests, and SEO and GEO setup.
Can AI replace an employee or a whole function? That is what the Integrator plan is for: ROBORAB is built into your company's internal processes and takes over the work of a specific person or area. You save money and time.
What is the Mentor mode? A $20 per month subscription ($18 if paid yearly) for those who don't have a business yet: the AI partner helps develop the idea, and commercial proposals and business plans are included.
Which languages is the site available in? The site and the agent chat are available in more than 50 languages. You change the language with the globe button in the top-right corner of the first screen.
